reviewed_reconstruction.manual_instructions: From native arrival(0,0,0), follow the declared native path north to(0,-42,2). Open actual chest26172, then follow the same route backwards to(0,0,0). Leaving the air-bubble route consumes oxygen and can fail. Restart begins a fresh attempt.

failure.text: Your oxygen ran out. You return to the entrance; follow the air bubbles and try again.
